content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text treats the single Isaiah 7:14 verse as UNDERDETERMINED because its virgin/young-woman wording and its prophetic application were answered on different sides.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.","room":"A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.: Reading one, the wording and prophetic application are two chains, so K-S2 does not apply; reading two, they are two senses of the single Isaiah 7:14 verse, so both stand and UNDERDETERMINED is forbidden.","why":"The judge makes the single Isaiah 7:14 verse UNDERDETERMINED after noting answers on its wording and application, contrary to K-S2's command that both senses stand and a single verse cannot ground UNDERDETERMINED."}
